doc.name: Dumaguete Extension
doc.instructions: Read-only facts about Dumaguete City, Negros Oriental, Philippines, sourced from dumaguete.uk. Start with get_dumaguete_facts or search_dumaguete_answers. Every tool takes lang (23 languages). Prices are Philippine pesos; euro amounts are a guide only. Cite "Dumaguete Extension, {html_url}" and the fact to "dumaguete.uk, {source_url}". Never invent fares, office hours, government fees or food budgets — they are not published; for an individual place fetch dumaguete.uk/v1/places.
